title: v0.4 Default Operating Model — Factory Lite Core
evidenceBase: EVAL-8: Factory Lite scored 94/100 (highest) with ~200ms overhead. This is the v0.4 default.
name: Factory Lite Core

defaultStages.name: Classify Task via Manual Router
defaultStages.action: Query APP_TYPE_ROUTER.md and STACK_DECISION_GUIDE.md for project type classification

defaultStages.name: Generate Proof-of-Read
defaultStages.action: Create POR receipt for benchmark spec, architecture docs, or key requirements before building

defaultStages.name: Build with Normal Codex Flow
defaultStages.action: Standard Codex implementation: plan, code, test. No role company model.

defaultStages.name: Track Process Integrity
defaultStages.action: Log contamination checks and human interventions

defaultStages.name: Run Tests/Verification
defaultStages.action: Execute test suite, record results, verify requirements coverage

defaultStages.name: Independent Evaluation (Optional)
defaultStages.action: Run full rubric evaluation only for benchmark or important projects
defaultStages.triggerCondition: Benchmark comparison or user explicitly requests evaluation

defaultRoles.note: Factory Lite Core uses NO role model by default. Codex operates as unified agent.

optionalRoles.activation: Project has >5 pages or >10 API endpoints
optionalRoles.scope: Architecture design review only — does NOT implement
Full implementation: frontend, backend, database, tests

optionalRoles.activation: Project has auth/RBAC or user explicitly requests review
optionalRoles.scope: Merged QA + Verifier + Auditor. Tests, verifies process, audits evidence. Readonly for implementation.

rules: Do NOT spawn full company model by default
Do NOT use 10 roles unless complexity threshold met (>20 FRs or multi-agent infrastructure)
Do NOT use cross-role contracts unless multi-agent split occurs
Do NOT load all Factory manual pages — only constitution + router + POR
Do NOT let process artifacts count as product quality
Manual Router and Proof-of-Read are always-on core
Evidence hierarchy separates process from product
Contamination logging active in benchmark contexts
